title: P.V. Sindhu storms into French Open semifinals
indian_angle: India's top shuttler P.V. Sindhu has advanced to the semifinals of a prestigious international tournament.
summary: P.V. Sindhu defeated Chiu Pin-Chian to secure her spot in the French Open semifinals, where she awaits her next opponent.

title: Menstrual health: A blind spot in Indian badminton
indian_angle: This deep dive highlights critical gaps in awareness and support for menstrual health among Indian badminton players.
summary: A new report reveals that menstrual health is poorly understood in Indian badminton, indicating a need for better awareness, training, and athlete support systems.

title: Indian para-shuttlers win multiple golds at Asian Para Games
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton players Nitesh Kumar, Naveen Sivakumar, Thulasimathi Murugesan, and Manasi Joshi clinched gold medals.
summary: Nitesh Kumar and Naveen Sivakumar secured men's singles gold, while Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Joshi won women's doubles gold at the Asian Para Games 2026.

title: Ashmita Chaliha fights hard but falls short in French Open quarterfinal
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha displayed a strong performance against Nozomi Okuhara in the French Open quarterfinals.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha showed resilience and attacking intent against Nozomi Okuhara but ultimately lost in three games in the French Open quarterfinal.

title: Ashmita Chaliha stuns World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Indian southpaw Ashmita Chaliha achieved a significant upset by defeating World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha defeated World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi 21-19, 21-18 at the French Open, becoming only the second Indian shuttler to beat the Japanese star.
